title: Gemini/agy harness cleanups after the Antigravity switch: dead as_cli_value, ungated agy probe tests, live-probe scratch dir, stale docs
outcome: The Antigravity harness change leaves no dead code, its deterministic probe tests run in a gate, the live probe cleans up, and docs describe agy acp.
acceptance: GeminiApprovalMode::as_cli_value (src/wire.rs:1248) is removed or used, so cargo check reports no dead_code warning for it.
The deterministic tests in scripts/agy-acp-contract.test.mjs run in the helper gate (helperTestFiles and the review-freeze workflow) while the live case stays opt-in.
The opt-in live probe removes its .tmp/agy-acp-contract-* scratch directory after recording its diagnostic.
docs/architecture.md (~1275), docs/features/agent-integration-comparison.md (~194) and README.md (~306) describe the native `agy acp` harness instead of `gemini --acp`.
